summary: All three phases of the provider-contract-discoverability run delivered exactly what the plan specified. Phase-01 added the full orient provider contract to cliDocs with all 13 normative tokens and regenerated the usage spec, docs, and README generated section. Phase-02 annotated the orient.command and gate-step output schema fields and appended the expected-shape suffix to both diagnostics provider-error branches. Phase-03 shipped two dependency-free Node scripts in examples/hello-world, updated phax.json, added the README Configure subsection, and wrote an integration test that validates both scripts against phax's own decoders. Commit subjects match the plan exactly; all planned files were touched and no unplanned files were modified; all promised tests are present.
